description: She wears a floor-length ivory gown with a square neckline, fitted bodice and elbow-length sleeves. Broad gold-and-brown geometric embroidered bands decorate the neckline, shoulders, sleeve ends, waist and skirt front and hem. A gold medallion belt with a narrow hanging ornament circles the waist. A mustard-gold and dark patterned fringed wrap rests around her arms. The skirt has a front walking opening below the knee, revealing part of one lower leg and an embroidered gold-brown closed shoe. Gold filigree drop earrings and a small ring complete the outfit.
